Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Trigger wrote:
> Do all newer reprinted cards supersede older versions? Like Hidden Lurker, delaying tactics, misdirection, concealed weapon and so on?
>
The only source for up-to-date cardtexts is the  cardlist .

Do not trust printed cards, as they could:
- no be up-to-date (Majesty does cost 1 blood, sorry Jyhad fan-boys)
- be incorrect (latest print of Approximation of Loyalty reads "Only usable by a vampire of capacity 5 or more" when it should read "Only usable by a vampire of capacity 7 or more")
- have been errated (Villein now only affects your own Minion Taps, not those of other players).

Messages.Author: Squidalot
Messages.Body: Do be clear the newest printed version of a card isn't necessarily correct text either due to changes [Villein/Psyche] or error in the reprint [Antionette duChamp/Imogen] so the card text link is best if you have any particular concerns around card text.
